   - Field operator (EdgeGrid) performs physical seal verification and hash check.
   - Redwood field engineer (Jonas) performs live checksum verification against the manifest and records the agent log.
2) Audit artifacts we require on acceptance
   - Signed-manifest.json (you supplied)
